Synthetic Earth pipeline test fixture

All coordinates, elevations, roads, airport names and runway records are fabricated
for software tests. They are not survey data and must never be used for navigation.
No NOAA, GRIP, OurAirports or other third-party dataset is included.

To the extent possible under law, the fixture authors dedicate this original
synthetic test data to the public domain under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
